name: SoftBank-Sesterce Bosquel AI data center
summary: A joint venture majority-owned by SoftBank Group and formed with Sesterce was selected to develop and operate a 1 GW AI data center campus in Bosquel, Somme, in the Hauts-de-France region. Announced on 2026-05-30 as part of the 2026 Choose France summit, it is one of three named Hauts-de-France sites in SoftBank's 5 GW France plan. No investment figure, construction schedule or permit status has been published for the site; SoftBank cites about 400 long-term jobs once it operates.

location.note: Nominatim centroid of the commune of Bosquel (Somme); sources name the commune only.

parties.name: SoftBank Group
parties.note: Majority owner of the joint venture.

parties.name: Sesterce
parties.note: Joint venture partner; the venture as a whole was selected to develop and operate the campus.

parties.name: Communauté de communes Somme Sud-Ouest
parties.note: Named as a partner; the Somme prefect refers to a call for expressions of interest launched by the CC2SO, the community of communes' abbreviation.

milestones.note: Announced in Paris alongside SoftBank's 5 GW France plan at Choose France 2026.

notes: SoftBank's France plan gives an initial EUR 45 billion for 3.1 GW across Dunkirk (Loon-Plage), Bosquel and Bouchain by 2031, without a per-site split, so no investment is attributed to Bosquel. The campus design is by architecture firm Patriarche.
